feeds.title: Czechology » Recipes
feeds.description: This is a blog about Czech customs and traditions, Czech food, and of course traveling. Czechology is the best guide to the Czech Republic and Old Czechoslovakia that is not only focused on tourism, but also on the people, gastronomy, etc. Find seasonal special recipes, food guides, cookbooks, authentic foods, etc., and explore Czech.

feeds.title: Cook Like Czechs
feeds.description: Discover traditional Czech food recipes and a little more about the Czech Republic, a small country in the very heart of Europe. I cook and share mostly Czechoslovakian recipes here. Czech and Slovak cuisine is very traditional with many unique dishes, like svickova sauce or sweet kolaches. I've got some fabulous Czech cookbooks on hand and would love to share them with you.

feeds.title: Czech Cookbook
feeds.description: Honoring Czech heritage by unlocking timeless recipes for new generations. By breathing new life into authentic Czech meals, thus unlocking them for newer generations of English-speaking Czechs all over the world. Providing free, highly detailed tutorial videos that allow even beginners to master the most traditional Czech meals.

feeds.title: Toprecepty.cz
feeds.description: Toprecepty.cz blog features cooking recipes for beginners and experienced cooks. Not just that, everyone can add their own recipes as well. Save your favorite recipes and recipe notes. Get amazing gifts and rewards on uploading your first recipe and also get an opportunity to inspire many people as your recipe can be seen by over 2.5 million visitors every month!

feeds.title: Kitchenette
feeds.description: This is a blog full of colors, healthy, modern, children's, sous vide, video, and traditional recipes, lots of inspiration, and a love for cooking. Here you will find ideas, tips, and even moments of rest and relaxation while scrolling through beautiful pages full of tempting photos. Blog posts are created on the go, based on what I have in the fridge, what I get from relatives from the garden, or what we grow ourselves.

feeds.title: Radka Horaczech
feeds.description: Ahoy! I'm Radka. Food blogger and personal chef. Welcome and czech out my recipes! I am always on the lookout for exotic, creative foods. I admire chefs who think outside the box. I love culinary travel and you can also hire me as a personal chef for your next event. You can sign up for recipes, reviews and tips sent once a week right to you.

feeds.title: Julia Recipes » Czech Cuisine
feeds.description: This blog offers a wide range of my favorite homemade recipes, which I love to cook and bake, on repeat, for my family and friends. Some recipes are inherited from my families such as Apple Strudel or Roasted pork with dumplings and sauerkraut, and on some recipes where I took a little modern healthy-ish twist such as Alfredo zucchini noodles. I have also special sections on this blog, dedicated to Czech cuisine, and you should check it out, I am sure, you'll love it.

feeds.title: Taste of Prague Blog
feeds.description: You will find the best Prague food tips and Prague restaurant guide here. Our food tours are just the starting point of what we do: make sure you have a great time in Prague. We have only two goals for your Prague stay, first is that you leave loving it and second is that you leave two pounds heavier. At least. And that's a promise.

feeds.title: Fun Food Travelling » Czech Republic
feeds.description: Life is a great adventure, go and live it! This is a food and travel blog where we share our passion for traveling, eating, and exploring the world. Let's travel together! Czech food has a long history but not everyone knows what are the typical Czech dishes you have to try when traveling to Prague and in this blog we help you explore the Czech cuisine and enjoy to your tummy's fullest.

feeds.title: Food Perestroika » Czech Food
feeds.description: My goal is to rebuild culinary traditions from the former Eastern Bloc and try to re-imagine and elevate them to haute cuisine. I am interested in innovation inspired by what came before, and in making the most of the ingredients and flavors that can be found in that part of the world. You can also learn to cook authentic Czech meals in the comfort of your home.

feeds.title: Vaření.cz
feeds.description: Discover something good. There are tens of thousands of proven recipes and hundreds of inspiring articles. You can easily create your own online cookbook here! Follow the blog to learn more about our food-related internet portal.

feeds.title: Living Prague » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Living Prague shares general advice about the city, local knowledge on hotels and attractions, specific advice about a place to stay, walking tour inquiries, etc. on this website. The site seeks to help people prepare for a visit to Prague, to highlight resources that you might like to use, to give advice on areas and places to stay, and loads of other stuff that only people who live here can bring to the web. Know about local cafes, food and so much more here.
